purpose: Define the Standard commercial tier as EUR 100 + VAT per site/year with community support and declared shared-service entitlements.

value.price_rule: EUR 100 + VAT per licensed site per year under the current commercial model.
value.iam_rule: The fee economically anchors/maintains the licensed organization's IAM identity/account relationship in the AIGM ecosystem.
value.rendezvous_rule: Official rendezvous/signaling service access is included for license holders under applicable service policy.
value.cert_validation_rule: Online certification validation service access is included.
value.oem_rule: OEM/embedded rights are not part of Standard unless explicitly amended.
value.authority_rule: Standard entitlement never bypasses IAM/AccessCore/runtime governance.
